content: Previous works from BIBREF5 , BIBREF6 , BIBREF7 have focused on disambiguating whether a space functions as the sentence boundary. These works extract contextual features from words and POS around the space. Then, the obtained features around the corresponding space are input into traditional models to predict whether space is a sentence boundary.
